description: This file defines the DetailActivity class, an Android Activity responsible for displaying detailed information about an item, including an image and title. It handles shared element transitions and loads images using Picasso.

classes.name: DetailActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that shows detailed information about an item, supporting scene transitions and asynchronous image loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, retrieves the item via intent, and assigns transition names for shared element transitions.

methods.name: loadItem
methods.description: Populates the UI with the item's details and manages image loading based on Android version and transition status.

methods.name: loadThumbnail
methods.description: Loads the thumbnail image into the ImageView using Picasso.

methods.name: loadFullSizeImage
methods.description: Loads the full-size image into the ImageView using Picasso.

methods.name: addTransitionListener
methods.description: Attaches a TransitionListener to the shared element enter transition to load the full-size image after transition completes.
